record: China Ministry of Culture announcement of the opening, 2005
facts: The complex opened at its Fen River site in 2005. The main building’s shape evokes a dou and a ding.
The four-story main building occupies the meeting of two axes and is surrounded by four service annexes. The central roof brings daylight to an octagonal interior hall.
The main building widens by floor; the four auxiliary pavilions contain additional exhibition, lecture, research and administration space. The formal gate and press-described frontage lie east.
